book.name: APOCALIPSIS
book.title: YIN̈ TZET AKꞌLAX YOHTAN̈ELO NAJ SAN JUAN YU COMAM JESUCRISTO

content: Ebnaj cawan̈ yakꞌ isba yalni Istzotiꞌ Comam Dios

Lahwi tuꞌ yakꞌlax huneꞌ malbal wetan, hacaꞌ teꞌ ah. Yallax wetan hacaꞌ tiꞌ: —Ahan̈wanoj cat hawoc hamalen yatut Comam Dios yebpaxo meẍa yet xahanbal, cat habisni hanta mac ayicto yinoyo isba tet Comam.
Yajaꞌ wal yamakꞌil yeb yin̈la ishoyanil mach chamale yuto chiakꞌlax tet ebnaj nan con̈obal, cat isxan̈nayo ebnaj iscon̈ob Comam Dios yulbal cuarenta y dos ixahaw.
Chiwatijan cawan̈ inchejaban chakꞌ isba yalnilo intzotiꞌan yulbal mil doscientos sesenta tzꞌayic. Ayco huntekꞌan xilkꞌape yet biscꞌulal yin̈ ebnaj, ẍi wetan.
Yechel ebnaj cawan̈ tiꞌ ye teꞌ cabeb yoj olivo yeb chꞌen cabeb candelero bay chiahto cantil ayco sata Comam Dios, Comam yahaw txꞌo txꞌotxꞌ.

Ta ay mac choche chioc etloco yin̈ ebnaj cawan̈ tiꞌ chielti kꞌaꞌ yul istiꞌ ebnaj, cat isn̈usnicanto ebnaj mac chichiwa iscꞌul yin̈ ebnaj. Hac tuꞌ chu iscamcanilo macta chiwatxꞌen istxꞌojal yin̈ ebnaj.

Aypaxo yip ebnaj ismajchen satcan̈ yun̈e matxa chakꞌ haꞌ n̈ab yulbal tzꞌayic bay chal ebnaj Istzotiꞌ Comam. Aypaxo yip ebnaj yanico ha haꞌ chicꞌal, yebpaxo xin ay yip ebnaj yakꞌni ecꞌoyaꞌ yanma anma ay sat txꞌo txꞌotxꞌ yu ej isyaꞌtajil, hantaticꞌa el choche iscꞌul ebnaj.

Hayet chilahwi yalnicꞌo ebnaj cawan̈ tuꞌ Istzotiꞌ Comam Dios, ay huneꞌ naj Nokꞌ isbi chiahilo yul huneꞌ niman xab; chaco naj howal yin̈ ebnaj cawan̈ tuꞌ cat iskꞌoji naj yin̈ ebnaj, cat ispotxꞌlax ebnaj yu naj Nokꞌ isbi tuꞌ. Yanico naj Nokꞌ isbi howal yin̈ ebnaj, chiahilo yul huneꞌ niman xab. Chikꞌoji naj yin̈ ebnaj cawan̈ tuꞌ

Chicancano pacꞌno isnimanil ebnaj yul iscallehal huneꞌ niman con̈ob bay alaxcan̈ Comam Jesucristo yin̈ teꞌ culus, Comam Yahawil ebnaj. Huneꞌ con̈ob tuꞌ challax Sodoma yeb Egipto yin̈, haꞌ chalniloj ta txꞌoj tzet chiswatxꞌe.
Sunil anma nananta con̈obal, nananta anmahil, nananta yabxubal, nananta nime con̈obal chiilni isnimanil ebnaj yulbal yicta iscan̈ tzꞌayic; mach chisje anma ta chimujlax ebnaj.

Yuxin sunil anma yul sat yiban̈kꞌinal tiꞌ caw oc yin̈ tzalahilal yu iscamical ebnaj. Yakꞌni anma sabehal tet hunun yu tzalahilal, yuto ebnaj cawan̈ ischejab Comam tuꞌ caw yakꞌ ebnaj ecꞌoyaꞌ yanma anma.
Lahwin̈e yicta iscan̈ tzꞌayic tuꞌ, yulcan̈ iscꞌul ebnaj cawan̈ tuꞌ yu Comam Dios, yahwano ebnaj. Haꞌ xin sunil anma ilni huneꞌ tuꞌ caw occano xiwquilal yin̈.

Yaben ebnaj cawan̈ tuꞌ huneꞌ yul nukꞌe awi yin̈ caw ip yul satcan̈, yalni hacaꞌ tiꞌ: —Ahan̈weti bey tiꞌ, ẍi tet ebnaj. Isto ebnaj satcan̈ xol huneꞌ moyan, sunil ebnaj ayco ishowal yin̈ ebnaj ilni huneꞌ tuꞌ.

Yin̈ena tuꞌ yecꞌ huneꞌ niman chixcab istan̈ilo huneꞌ islahon̈eb majan teꞌ n̈a yul huneꞌ niman con̈ob tuꞌ, hujeb mil anma cam yu huneꞌ chixcab tuꞌ. Wal anma mach cami caw xiwi, yanico ismay Comam Dios ay yul satcan̈.
Hac tuꞌ yu yecꞌto iscab isyaꞌtajil, tinan̈ xin yichixapaxico huneꞌ isyox isyaꞌtajil.
Yet yokꞌtzelax chꞌen ishuj trompeta
Hayet yokꞌtzen naj ishuj ángel istrompeta yabelax huneꞌ yul nukꞌe awi yin̈ caw ip yul satcan̈, yalni:

content.text: Sunil tzet ay yip yul sat yiban̈kꞌinal tiꞌ chioccano yul iskꞌab Comam Dios Jahawil yeb yul iskꞌab Comam Jesucristo, cat yoccano yahawil yin̈ sunilbal tiempo, ẍi.

content: Wal ebnaj veinticuatro anciano tzꞌon̈an yul istzꞌon̈obal sata Comam Dios ay jahno ebnaj, yay xulno ebnaj, yanico ebnaj ismay Comam.
Yalni ebnaj:

content.text: Mam Jahawil, hach tiꞌ coDiosalan̈, caw aycano hawip. Ayach tinan̈, ayach yet yalan̈tocanoj yeb yin̈ sunilbal tiempo. Chijakꞌan̈ yuchꞌandiosal tawet yuto chachoc hayébaloj ta caw aycano hawip, yeb xin cachichico hawoc yahawil.

Caw tit ishowal ej con̈ob tawin̈, yajaꞌ maapni istiempohal hawanayo isyaꞌtajil yiban̈ anma. Maapnipaxo istiempohal hawilni yin̈ tzet chielico ej camom, cat hawakꞌni ispaj selel tet ebnaj hachejab yet payat, ebnaj chihalnicꞌo Hatzotiꞌ. Chawakꞌnipaxo ispaj selel tet sunil mac hawetxa yehi yeb macta chixiw tawet, macta ay yelapnoj, yeb macta mach yelapnoj, cat hatan̈tzencanilo macta chietanto anma ay sat txꞌo txꞌotxꞌ, ẍi ebnaj.

content: Lahwi tuꞌ, ishajni isba yatut Comam Dios yul satcan̈, chi-xin-jilicto huneꞌ caẍa yet istrato Comam ayicto yul yatut tuꞌ. Yichico isjepla cꞌuh, iskꞌan̈i satcan̈, isn̈irlapaxoj, yecꞌ huneꞌ chixcab, yakꞌnipaxo huneꞌ niman sajbat.
